Name: Display Monster Health
Author: atesba
Description:
[b][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+[/size][/b]

Adds a text that display monster health below them.
You can configure the size, color, background of HP text.
There are options to show health as absolute value or percentage.

Leave a comment if you have any feature ideas you'd like to see in this mod!
I initially coded this mod in 1 day for my own use, but thought I should share with the community. It's my first mod, hope you enjoy it!
Adding new features as I come up with them while playing.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿ is recommended or you can directly edit config.json file.
Also supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] ﻿for color configs. You can still change colors in mod config menu without this mod, but it is easier/prettier with it.

[list]
[*][b]Enable[/b]: Display monster health.
[*][b]ToggleKey[/b]: Press to toggle display.
[*][b]ShowInvisibleMonsters[/b]: Shows health even for invisible monsters. Also affects hidden/indistinguishable/invulnerable monsters such as rock crab, rock golem, armored bug, grub. (Let me know if I should add any other monsters here).
[*][b]HideOnFullHealth[/b]: Hide health display if the monster is on full health. It will show up once they take damage.
[*][b]ShowAbove[/b]: Display health above monster instead of below.
[*][b]NoJumping[/b]: If enabled, health display stays still for jumping monsters such as Dust Sprite.
[*][b]OffsetX[/b]: Offset health display in x axis.
[*][b]OffsetY[/b]: Offset health display in y axis.
[*][b]ShowMaxHealth[/b]: Show max health next to current health.
[*][b]FixMaxHealth[/b]: Some monsters have higher health than their maximum. Enabling this adjusts the displayed max health so it feels more natural. This option also affects percentage and health decay color.
[*][b]ShowPercentage[/b]: Replaces absolute health with percentage.
[*][b]﻿FontSize[/b]: Changes the font of health text. Options: 1, 2, 3. Defaults to 2 if you put anything else.
[*][b]HealthDecay[/b]: Change color as health decreases. You can still adjust the text color alpha value (recommended to leave at max) and background color.
[*][b]HealthDecayColor[/b]: Color gradient for health decay (0-6).
[*][b]﻿TextColor[/b]: 0-255 RGBA values for text color. (A is alpha. Adjusts opacity).
[*][b]﻿BackgroundEnable[/b]: Puts a rectangle background to make text more readable.
[*][b]﻿BackgroundColor[/b]: 0-255 RGBA values for background color. (A is alpha. Adjusts opacity).
[/list][b][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/b]
[list]
[*](Possibly) due to a bug in SMAPI or the game itself, when Zoom is 100% but UI Scale is anything other than 100%, texts show up at wrong positions. Until it's fixed I suggest playing at a different zoom level.
[*]If you update the mod from a version older than 1.2.0, color configs are set to 0 and text becomes transparent. This is a one time only issue, just set your colors to what you like and it won't happen again in future updates.
[/list][b][size=4]To do:[/size][/b]

[/list]
